questions.question: Higher A microwave has a wavelength of 6 cm. Calculate its frequency.
questions.explanation: Answer: Q3: λ = 6 cm = 0.06 m. f = v ÷ λ = 3 × 10⁸ ÷ 0.06 = 5 × 10⁹ Hz (5 GHz)

questions.question: Foundation State the speed of all EM waves in a vacuum.
questions.correctAnswer: Q5: 3 × 10⁸ m/s (speed of light in a vacuum).
questions.explanation: Answer: Q5: 3 × 10⁸ m/s (speed of light in a vacuum).
